About Event

​The 2026 AI Symposium connects leaders across healthcare, biotechnology, academia, law, and finance to inspire collaboration and explore artificial intelligence transforming science, medicine, and innovation.

​Food and drinks will be provided; business casual attire is expected.

​Confirmed speakers:

  • ​Jinfeng Zhang, PhD (Founder and CEO of Insilicom)

  • ​Linshu Li, PhD (Founding Member of Mercor)

  • ​Sam Samdani, PhD (Senior Emeritis, McKinsey; QuantumCT)

  • ​Abe Kwon, JD (Startup and VC Law, Lowenstein Sandler)

  • ​Nevin Ramanujan, MBA (InnovateHealth Ventures)

  • ​Guan Wang, PhD (Director of BD and Licensing, Insilico Medicine)

  • ​Rong Fan, PhD (Harold Hodgkinson Professor of Biomedical Engineering and of Pathology, Yale University)
